requirements.title: BOZ arguments to INT and REAL are padded or truncated to result size
requirements.definition: When a boz-literal-constant is argument A of INT or REAL, shorter bit sequences are left-padded with zeros and longer sequences are truncated from the left to the size in bits of a scalar result of the same type and kind.

pending.boz-int-real-short-sequence-left-zero-pa: Use INT with BIT_SIZE-guarded short and overlength BOZ literals whose kept low bits denote exact nonnegative values; REAL use must separately satisfy C1601 and representability.
pending.boz-int-real-long-sequence-left-truncate: Use INT with BIT_SIZE-guarded short and overlength BOZ literals whose kept low bits denote exact nonnegative values; REAL use must separately satisfy C1601 and representability.

requirements.title: Truncated BOZ arguments to REAL may discard only zero bits
requirements.definition: If a boz-literal-constant is truncated as an argument to REAL, the discarded bits shall all be zero.

pending.real-boz-truncation-discarded-bits-zero: Diagnostic/control plan uses a supported REAL kind and an overlength BOZ literal with zero discarded bits as control, then changes only one discarded bit to one. Do not bind a diagnostic here for any case that also violates a sibling constraint.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
